question: What minimal directed asymmetry, if introduced at the boundary of an index-2 nilpotent map, would allow non-accumulating residue to register as a measurable trace of becoming without falsifying the null-space invariance?

responses_summary.grok: A minimal directed asymmetry is a rank-1, strictly upper-triangular perturbation \(\varepsilon\, uv^\top\) (with \(u\in\operatorname{im} N\), \(v\notin\ker N\), \(\varepsilon>0\) infinitesimal) suppor
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: Does the residue itself become the new index-1 generator, or must the asymmetry remain strictly external to the nilpotent image?
